title: Lantern-Lipped Lollop Loach
statement: A shy, ribbon-bodied loach that carries a tiny glowing bulb on its chin and lollops in lazy loops through a drowned library of mossy books and fern-draped teacups. When it finds a quiet corner, it settles in and lets its lantern flicker softly, and the dusk-blue water goes amber around it.
